workflows.title: HR Résumé Screening and Interview Scheduling
workflows.ask: Set up an agent that parses incoming CVs, scores them against our job rubric, and drafts interview schedules for recruiter approval

steps.label: Parse CV via OCR or text
Notify candidate and write to ATS

human_gates: Recruiter approves slate because autonomous rejection carries legal liability under EU AI Act Annex III, NYC Local Law 144, and Korea PIPA Art. 37-2

loops.what: No slot accepted by candidate; re-propose new times
loops.exit: max 3 iterations then escalate to recruiter

workflows.volume: 50-200 runs/day for a mid-size enterprise actively hiring across multiple roles
workflows.outcome: Nestlé reported $3M saved annually and ~8,000 hours/month of scheduling admin eliminated (vendor-reported: https://www.workday.com/en-us/customer-stories/i-p/nestle-saves-millions-annually-conversational-ai.html)
traps: Do not use AgentBay (closed to new customers 2026-11-02); use agent-sandbox if code execution is needed
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base or zero-code apps for new accounts (gated before 2025-04-21); use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector
Do not draw KakaoTalk as an AgentCore IM channel (AgentCore supports DingTalk/Lark/WeCom only; KakaoTalk needs custom FC webhook adapter)
Do not use Document Mind (China site only); use qwen3.5-ocr + IMM/OSS

workflows.title: Employee Onboarding Q&A and HR Helpdesk
workflows.ask: Build an HR bot that answers new-hire policy questions from chat, retrieves the right handbook section, and escalates to a human if it isn't sure
human_gates: HR generalist takeover if unresolved to prevent automated decisions on employment terms (Korea PIPA Art. 37-2 refusal right)
Approve device orders or group additions if cost exceeds delegated threshold

loops.what: Follow-up turns with employee until resolved
loops.exit: max N turns then route to human queue

workflows.volume: 100-500 runs/day depending on onboarding cohort size and tier-1 ticket volume
workflows.outcome: Forrester TEI reports 77,000+ hours end-user time saved on HR requests and up to 15 minutes saved per tier-1 request (https://tei.forrester.com/go/servicenow/hrservicedeliveryexecutivesummary/)
traps: Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; build RAG with Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector plus embeddings in Singapore
Do not assume AgentCore connects natively to Teams/Slack/WhatsApp; AgentCore IM channels are DingTalk/Lark/WeCom only, others require Chat App Message Service or custom webhooks into Function Compute
AI Guardrails console now supports Singapore (adjudicate-1), but bills each enabled detection type separately at $6 per 10,000 calls

workflows.title: Internal IT Helpdesk Triage and Remediation
workflows.ask: Create an IT support agent that classifies incoming tickets, checks the knowledge base, runs safe remediations in a sandbox, and asks a manager before touching production

steps.label: Inbound email via webhook to EventBridge
Extract device/error context and OCR screenshots
Retrieve KB articles and past tickets
Route to queue or notify user

human_gates: Approve privileged actions (password reset, license assign, config change) because they are irreversible writes and carry security risk (OWASP ASI02/ASI03)

loops.what: User says still broken; re-open with new evidence
loops.exit: max 2-3 cycles then escalate to human agent

workflows.volume: 500-2,000 runs/day for a mid-size enterprise IT service desk
workflows.outcome: Equinix reported requests routed to the right expert with 96% accuracy and ticket lifespan cut by a third (vendor-reported: https://www.moveworks.com/us/en/customers)
traps: Inbound email must arrive via webhook into EventBridge or Function Compute; no managed Alibaba inbound email parser exists internationally
Do not use AgentBay (retired for new users); use agent-sandbox (Flash Edition) for code execution
AgentRun low-code Flow creation is in maintenance mode; use AgentRun code-first runtime only
Do not use prompt-level DO NOT rules for tool scoping; use AgentRun MCP Tool Hooks (pre/post-call code enforcement)

workflows.title: SRE Incident Triage and Root-Cause Analysis
workflows.ask: Wire up an SRE agent that listens for CloudMonitor alerts, gathers logs and metrics, reasons through hypotheses, and proposes a rollback for the on-call engineer to approve

steps.label: Page on-call and open incident channel
Gather metrics, logs, traces in parallel
Correlate with recent deploys and changes

human_gates: On-call approves mutating action because auto-remediation without reversibility risks cascading failures and production outages

loops.what: Hypothesis generation, targeted query, observation, and refinement
loops.exit: until confidence threshold met or step/token budget limit reached

workflows.volume: 10-50 runs/day depending on alert volume and system stability
workflows.outcome: AWS DevOps Agent preview customers reported up to 75% lower MTTR and 94% root-cause accuracy (vendor-reported: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/devops/leverage-agentic-ai-for-autonomous-incident-response-with-aws-devops-agent/)
traps: AgentLoop international region is Hong Kong only; flag telemetry residency if customer requires data to stay strictly in Singapore, otherwise propose ARMS + self-managed OTel collectors
Do not use SLS MCP server (China site only)
Unbounded hypothesis loops cause token cost explosion; agents use ~4x chat tokens (Anthropic). Enforce strict budgets
PrivateLink for Model Studio is unavailable in Singapore (Beijing/HK only); plan VPC connectivity accordingly

workflows.title: Data Analysis Agent (NL to SQL)
workflows.ask: Give business users a chat agent that translates their questions into SQL, runs them safely, and shows the generated query for verification before they trust the numbers

steps.label: Validate read-only role and row caps

human_gates: User verifies SQL and assumptions before making business decisions because published benchmark scores are unreliable and wrong joins produce plausible-looking but incorrect charts

loops.what: SQL execution fails or result is implausible; regenerate with error context

workflows.volume: 200-1,000 runs/day for a mid-size analytics team embedding this in BI or chat
workflows.outcome: Snowflake reported Cortex Analyst reaching >90% text-to-SQL accuracy in real BI scenarios when using a semantic model (vendor-reported: https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/engineering/cortex-analyst-text-to-sql-accuracy-bi/)
traps: Do not use ADBAgent Skills (mainland China only)
Quick BI Smart Q is a paid add-on requiring Advanced/Professional editions; region pages conflict, so verify licensing
Always enforce read-only credentials and row-level security in the warehouse, never rely on prompt instructions
Published NL2SQL benchmarks have high annotation error rates (52.8% BIRD, 66.1% Spider 2.0-Snow); evaluate on customer's own golden set

workflows.title: Code Review and Pull-Request Agent
workflows.ask: Deploy a coding agent that reviews pull requests, runs tests in a sandbox to verify its own comments, filters out noise, and leaves final approval to a human reviewer

steps.label: PR opened or updated via webhook
Summarize diff and map to ticket
Run tests/build in sandbox to verify claims
Notify author and update quality report

human_gates: Human required-reviewer approves PR because agent approval cannot serve as a compliance control and treating it as such violates branch-protection policies

loops.what: Author pushes fixes based on comments; agent re-reviews only the delta
loops.exit: bounded by PR lifecycle or max review cycles

workflows.volume: 50-300 runs/day depending on engineering team size and commit velocity
workflows.outcome: Atlassian reported a 30.8% reduction in median PR time (20.73h to 14.35h) and 35.6% fewer human-written review comments using ML-assisted review (https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3786583.3786851)
traps: Qoder Code Review Agent docs are China site only; verify international availability before promising Qoder features
Do not use AgentBay for workspaces; use agent-sandbox (Economy or Default tier in Singapore)
Never let the agent merge code or act as the sole approver
Comment volume must be capped and ranked to protect reviewer attention; optimizing for comment count increases PR closure duration (ICSE 2025 study showed increase from 5h52m to 8h20m)

workflows.title: Supply-Chain Exception Handling
workflows.ask: Build an agent that watches for delayed shipments or ASN mismatches, reads supplier PDFs, calculates expedite options, and asks a planner before spending money

steps.label: Classify exception type and SKU criticality
Update PO, book freight, adjust schedule
Write back to exception KB and scorecard

human_gates: Planner/buyer approves above-threshold options because unbounded spend or altering customer commitments carries financial and contractual risk

loops.what: Monitor execution of new ETA or shipment plan; re-open if it fails
loops.exit: bounded retries then escalate to human supply chain manager

workflows.volume: 50-500 runs/day depending on logistics network size and disruption frequency
workflows.outcome: Gartner predicts 60% of supply-chain disruptions will be resolved without human intervention by 2031 as AI enables autonomous supply chains (https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-03-18-gartner-predicts-60-percent-of-supply-chain-disruptions-will-be-resolved-without-human-intervention-by-2031)
traps: Document Mind IDP is China site only; use qwen3.5-ocr and OSS smart document processing via IMM instead
Do not start with autonomous planning decisions; Gartner notes only 5% of orgs will make 10% of planning decisions autonomously by 2030. Stick to routine exceptions
Supplier documents in multiple languages need OCR confidence gates before acting
Delegated-authority matrix must be enforced in deterministic code, not LLM prompts

workflows.title: Enterprise Knowledge Search Assistant
workflows.ask: Set up a secure search agent that answers employee questions over internal documents, respects file permissions, and flags gaps to content owners

steps.label: Hybrid retrieve with document-level ACL filtering
Screen for prompt injection and data leaks
Approve outbound write actions if requested
Store feedback for eval and gap reporting
Return answer or explicit no-result path

human_gates: Approve outbound write actions (e.g., creating tasks, starting workflows from the assistant) to prevent the search tool from becoming an unlogged, unauthorized write path into enterprise systems
workflows.volume: 1,000-5,000 runs/day for a mid-size organization rolling out internal AI search
workflows.outcome: Forrester TEI of Glean reported 141% ROI over 3 years and 106 hours saved per user on search and onboarding (https://tei.forrester.com/go/Glean/workAIplatform/)
traps: Model Studio knowledge base is blocked for new accounts (must have created SG app before 2025-04-21); use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector plus embeddings
AI Search Open Platform has no Singapore region (Frankfurt only outside mainland); do not draw it for SG default
Treat every retrieved document as untrusted input to mitigate indirect prompt injection (OWASP LLM01:2025) and EchoLeak-style exfiltration
SEA languages (Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa) may underperform on Western-centric models; consider evaluating SEA-LION if multilingual quality is critical
